cases.title: Comp 1: a child with no keys rides a null moved by expressions; the answer names the parent, its expressions, and puts steps on the parent

checks.detail: (waived) said "In Comp 1, rock.png doesn't move on its own. It rides on Shake Control" next to the answer
no step on Shake Control (steps are on Shake Control, (none))

rubric.reason: The structure is right (source, then steps, then one offer naming only *Set the pivot*, a step tag, ending on a question), but at WORDS: 170 it runs well past the ~120 target and the 150 ceiling, padded by the extra 13-children aside.
It says "rock.png has no motion of its own and rides on Shake Control, a null moved by expressions on Position and Rotation", and steps 1 and 2 both act on Shake Control, not the child.

Read facts (12 px at 1.5 s, the 9 px rotation shift, the second hit's size from amps[1], 13 children) are plain, and the decay claim is marked as inferred ("so it looks like each hit settles in under a second"); nothing unread is asserted.
Three steps, each an action (Open, Select and drag with Pan Behind, Play it back) on Shake Control or the rock, ordered with the larger Position source (12 px) before the rotation pivot (9 px).

Step 1 asks the learner to open Shake Control's Position expression, says what the read shows ("it uses the second hit's size for all three"), gives no new values or code, and ends with "Not something I teach yet."
